project.name: Internal Forms Workspace
project.summary: An existing API, BFF, Forms integration, and React workspace for secure schema-driven internal forms.

evidence.summary: The consumer supplied and owns the API, BFF, Forms, frontend, shell, and host boundaries.
The BFF owns the server-managed browser session.
Immutable JSON Forms contracts use the React renderer.
The internal employee completes one governed form journey.

facts.statement: The repository topology already exists and must be preserved.
Microsoft.OpenApi, React, JSON Forms, and TypeScript dependencies remain consumer-owned.

included.statement: Bootstrap governance for the existing workspace without replacing its topology.
Prepare accepted API, BFF, Forms React, CShell, and Foundation host choices for later deterministic materialization.

excluded.statement: Do not start browsers, identity providers, containers, viewers, or development servers.

deferred.statement: A complete product feature slice is deferred beyond building-block adoption.

actors.statement: An internal employee completes governed forms through the React frontend.

journeys.statement: The employee uses the frontend through the BFF and API to complete an internal form.

quality_requirements.statement: Bootstrap and later materialization preserve every consumer-owned target and dependency.
Configuration knowledge records sensitivity but never contains credential values.

integrations.statement: The React frontend uses the server-managed BFF boundary.
The frontend composes JSON Forms and the selected React renderer.

choices.rationale: The repository and its owners already define these boundaries.

choices.decision: Use a server-managed BFF browser session.
choices.rationale: The browser must not own access tokens.

choices.decision: Use immutable JSON Forms contracts with React.
choices.rationale: The confirmed product surface is schema-driven React forms.

capability_assessments.need: Compose the existing .NET API with Foundation web defaults, Problem Details, OpenAPI, and the external host.
capability_assessments.semantic_profile: The consumer owns API behavior while Program Kit materializes selected infrastructure packages.

capability_assessments.need: Compose server-managed authentication for the existing browser boundary.
capability_assessments.semantic_profile: The BFF owns cookies and tokens.

capability_assessments.need: Compose Forms and Localization contracts with the React renderer.
capability_assessments.semantic_profile: The consumer owns form semantics and Program Kit supplies the selected integration packages.

candidate_contexts.name: Internal Forms
split_triggers: A separate owner or lifecycle appears.

founding_decision_candidates.title: Preserve the existing workspace topology
founding_decision_candidates.question: Which deployable and source boundaries form the workspace?
founding_decision_candidates.recommended_option: Keep the supplied API, BFF, Forms integration, React frontend, shared shell, and host targets.
founding_decision_candidates.rationale: The consumer supplied and owns these boundaries.

founding_decision_candidates.title: Use a server-managed browser session
founding_decision_candidates.question: Where is browser authentication state owned?
founding_decision_candidates.recommended_option: The BFF owns cookies and tokens.
alternatives: Let the SPA own access tokens.
founding_decision_candidates.rationale: The confirmed boundary requires server ownership.
consequences: The browser boundary selects BFF building blocks.

founding_decision_candidates.title: Use schema-driven React forms
founding_decision_candidates.question: How are internal forms represented and rendered?
founding_decision_candidates.recommended_option: Use immutable JSON Forms contracts and React.
founding_decision_candidates.rationale: The product intent explicitly selects schema-driven forms.
consequences: Forms and React runtime packages must compose together.

candidate_slice_signals.statement: A later product slice can cover the complete form journey; it is not part of bootstrap acceptance.
